CANONICAL_NAME.value: GNU APL 2.0 -- a free interpreter for the array language APL (ISO 13751), by Juergen Sauermann

value.lineage: APL (Iverson, 1962; 'A Programming Language'): a notation that computes on whole arrays with a dense set of primitive functions and operators, no explicit loops -- the founding array-language culture (ancestor of J, K, kdb+, and of array thinking in NumPy). GNU APL (2013-) is a complete ISO-standard interpreter in C++. The vault's first array language; a genuinely different execution model (rank-polymorphic whole-array operations) from every other specimen.

value.built_to: express computation as operations on whole arrays in a compact notation, without explicit iteration
value.pressure: the human problem of concise mathematical/array notation; APL's terseness and non-ASCII glyphs are the cost
value.success_means: an array expression yields the same result a looped program would, in one line

value.pressure: notational density; whole-array thinking versus element-at-a-time
value.failure_condition: rank/shape errors (LENGTH ERROR, RANK ERROR) when arrays do not conform

cut.note: APL's right-to-left evaluation with no operator precedence is implemented as a shift/reduce parser over token CLASSES (A value, F function, M monadic operator, D dyadic operator, V variable, ASS assignment, brackets, END) with a generated phrase table; the reduction rules ARE the language's semantics

provenance.grade_basis: Techne FOSSIL_PACKET.json PROVENANCE_GRADE where issued, else the record's handoff string mapped (populated per R34; Harmonia may re-grade)

organs.human_name: Prefix::reduce_statements (900-935): grow (shift) / reduce; MAX_REDUCTION_LEN = 6; the phrase table (Prefix.def, generated by tools/phrase_gen)
organs.mechanism: tokens of a statement are pushed right to left onto a stack; after each shift the top up to six token classes are looked up in a phrase table (hash or search tree, a compile-time choice); a matching phrase's reduce_* function replaces the matched tokens with one result token and returns an R_action (retry matching, shift, or done); the loop continues until the statement reduces to a single value or an error; the table is generated from a phrase list, not hand-written
organs.output: a value token or an error with the PC rewound to the statement start
organs.state: the token stack; the PC into the body
assumptions: APL's grammar is decidable on token CLASSES with six tokens of lookahead; the class of a name (function vs value) is known at run time, which is why the stack holds classes resolved late
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: right-to-left evaluation, operators binding tighter than functions, and bracket indexing all fall out of the phrase order; no precedence table
organs.failure_landscape: by reading: an ambiguity that needs more than six tokens cannot be expressed; the R_action protocol lets a reduction re-classify a token and retry
organs.human_prior: LALR(1)-style parsing (the comment says so) applied to a language usually described as 'no parser needed'

organs.human_name: Prefix::reduce_A_F_B_ (dyadic), reduce_F_B_ (monadic), reduce_A_M_B_ / reduce_F_M__ (operators), reduce_V_ASS_B_ (assignment), reduce_LBRA_* (indexing), reduce_END_* / reduce_*_GOTO_* (statement end, branch), 40 in all
organs.mechanism: each phrase shape has a function: A F B applies function F dyadically to values A and B; F B monadically; an operator M or D with its function operands builds a derived function token before application; V ASS B assigns; the bracket rules build index lists; the END and GOTO rules finish a statement or branch the PC; the rules call into the primitive implementations (Bif_*) and return how to continue
assumptions: every APL construct is one of ~40 shapes over 6 classes
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: the language's semantics are a flat list of 40 cases, each readable in isolation
organs.source_boundary: the reduce_* functions; MEDIUM because bodies were not read

rejected_cuts.candidate: Value/Cell (the array model: shapes, ravel, cell types), the ~200 primitive functions and operators, the workspace (Archive), I/O and the )commands, the emacs/XML tooling
rejected_cuts.note: the array model (Value.cc, 3,244 lines) is the other mechanism family of APL and is unread

rejected_cuts.evidence: the evaluation-order machinery (this cut) and the array primitives (unread) are separable: the same parser could drive a different array model

pressures.condition: tokens whose grammatical class (value, function, operator) is known only at run time; evaluation is strictly right to left with operators binding tighter than functions; the organism has bounded lookahead
pressures.resource_or_constraint: six tokens of lookahead; one phrase table
pressures.failure_condition: a wrong reduction on an ambiguous prefix, or a construct that needs more lookahead
pressures.world_punishes: a precedence table (wrong for APL) and a full parse tree (impossible before classes are known)
pressures.observable_consequence: statements evaluated correctly vs a reference interpreter over the ISO APL test corpus, with the lookahead cap varied
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: a reference interpreter as oracle (which is what a Stage C run would use)
pressures.cheat_control: an organism given each token's class in advance must parse with lookahead 3; the ancestor with the class hint removed must need the retry protocol: the world must show the difference
